messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2025-10-02 14:20 UTC for release r-2025-10-02-0842 started (targets: 10% -> 40%). Health check failures detected in snapshot shard service: 4xx/5xx spike at 14:22. Error rates: canary=12.3% vs baseline=0.2%.
caroline: seeing 502s from snapshot-store proxy, stacktrace snippet in logs: `ErrWriteTimeout -> kvcache.Put`
ajay: paging oncall (ajay) now. What region?
matt: EU-west canary is where the spike originates. Affected route: `/v1/snapshot/create` heavy from batch jobs. Potential bad model snapshot write in this deploy.
lisa: support is getting multiple customer reports about failed document saves. Ticketing:  #INC-3421 linked. Impact: some customers retry, user-facing failures.
infrabot: autoscaler events: burst in pod restarts (OOMKilled x3) around 14:21 -> possible memory regression from new snapshot code.
caroline: can we flip the feature-flag for snapshot-redesign? fflag `snapshot_v2` is targeted for 25% rollout.
matt: yes, do kill-switch now. ajay you have permissions?
ajay: I have admin. Doing fflag toggle: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"snapshot_v2","env":"prod","state":"off"}'`
ajay: (runs) -> response 200, flag state: off. Rolling back to snapshot_v1 for new requests.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic adjusted to 5% while flag is off. Monitoring: error rate for canary decreased to 4.1% at 14:26 but still above baseline.
caroline: initiating controlled rollback of r-2025-10-02-0842 from canary pool. Command: `rbctl rollback --release r-2025-10-02-0842 --scope canary --drain`
ajay: rollback started. Draining canary hosts now. Notifying load balancer to remove canary pool.
oncall: I'll take point for the remainder. Handing off from ajay -> oncall. Please ping for any customer escalations.
lisa: informing customers via status page: "We are investigating increased errors for snapshot saves in EU; mitigation in progress."
infrabot: CDN and LB reports: traffic successfully diverted off canary at 14:29. Pod restarts reduced.
matt: once rollback completes, verify end-to-end by replaying sample save flow against canary-removed endpoints.
caroline: rollback complete at 14:33. Post-rollback canary error rate back to 0.4% at 14:36.
oncall: verifying incident impact: ~120 failed snapshot operations in the 14:20-14:33 window, ~65 unique customer orgs, highest severity on batch ingestion jobs. Notified account execs for top 10 impacted.
lisa: support status updated. Customers with retries should be ok; created follow-ups for manual resume where needed.
matt: root cause suspected memory regression in snapshot write path introduced in `snapshot_v2` code path under load; schedule hotfix PR and quant test.
caroline: action items: 1) revert snapshot_v2 from main (done by ajay) 2) add memory stress test for snapshot path (owner: eng-runtime) 3) add canary throttling to prevent batch-job-surge hitting canary (owner: infra)
oncall: I'll keep this thread open for timeline updates. If no further regressions by +2 hours we'll mark resolved. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Incident created INC-3421, severity: P2, status: mitigated -> monitoring.
